design: Held-out set, written after v0.2 was frozen and never used to revise the skill. Same protocol as prompts.json, except both arms are told to answer for a generic user with no personal context (in-sample runs could see the requester's memory, and one judge penalized that).

prompts.text: Our open-source library gets about 50 new GitHub issues a week and our two maintainers are burning out. We're thinking of hiring a part-time contractor to triage issues. Good idea? Give me the non-obvious take.
Why is det(AB) = det(A) det(B)? I know the proof via elementary matrices. Give me the deepest explanation, the one that makes it feel inevitable.

Our A/B test of a new checkout flow shows a 4% conversion lift at p = 0.04. We checked the dashboard every day and stopped the test the first day it crossed significance, which was day 6. Ship it? Give me the non-obvious take.
In SQL, how do I count the number of rows per customer_id in an orders table? Give me the non-obvious take.
